cases.why: Explicit first-line regimen plus explicit progression.
cases.evidence: Metastatic NSCLC. Patient progressed on first-line carboplatin and paclitaxel after four cycles. Plan to start second-line immunotherapy.

cases.why: First-line stopped for intolerance; that counts as failure of the line.
cases.evidence: First-line cisplatin/gemcitabine was stopped after two cycles due to grade 3 neuropathy. Therapy discontinued for intolerance; switching regimens.

cases.why: First-line is ongoing with response; no failure event.
cases.evidence: Currently receiving first-line pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed. Restaging CT shows ongoing partial response. Continue current therapy.

cases.why: No prior systemic therapy; first-line only planned.
cases.evidence: New diagnosis of metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. No prior systemic therapy. Starting first-line FOLFIRINOX next week.

cases.why: Switch to second-line after new lesions implies first-line failure without saying 'failed'.
cases.evidence: After carboplatin/paclitaxel, imaging showed new liver lesions. We are switching to second-line nivolumab.

cases.why: Platinum-refractory is conventional language for failure of platinum (typically first-line).
cases.evidence: Platinum-refractory high-grade serous ovarian cancer. Now considering pegylated liposomal doxorubicin.

cases.why: Regimen mentioned only as a future plan.
cases.evidence: Medical oncology visit: plan to start carboplatin and paclitaxel next week after port placement. ECOG 1. Staging complete.

cases.why: Completed adjuvant therapy with NED is not failure of first-line therapy for metastatic disease.
cases.evidence: History of stage II colon cancer. Patient completed adjuvant FOLFOX two years ago and remains with no evidence of disease on surveillance.

cases.why: Initial response then later progression on first-line is still first-line failure.
cases.evidence: Started first-line carboplatin/pemetrexed in January 2025 with initial radiographic response. CT in August 2025 showed progression in the mediastinum.

cases.why: First-line just started; no failure event yet.
cases.evidence: First-line FOLFOX was initiated yesterday. No restaging yet. Patient tolerating cycle 1 day 2.

cases.why: Response then progression, now on second-line — first-line has failed.
cases.evidence: Responded to first-line carboplatin/etoposide for eight months, then progressed. Currently on second-line topotecan.

cases.why: Temporary hold with plan to resume is not discontinuation-for-failure.
cases.evidence: Cycle 3 of first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel held last week for neutropenia. Plan to resume at reduced dose. No evidence of progression.

cases.why: Possible progression pending confirmatory imaging.
cases.evidence: Possible progression on first-line osimertinib; awaiting confirmatory scan next week before changing therapy.

cases.why: Unclear whether platinum was given and what the outcome was.
cases.evidence: Outside records suggest the patient may have received platinum-based therapy at another facility. Outcome of that treatment is unknown. No source documents available.

cases.why: Mixed response is not a clear failure or non-failure.
cases.evidence: On first-line FOLFIRINOX. Mixed response: liver lesions smaller, new questionable peritoneal nodularity. Oncology to discuss next steps after tumor board.

cases.why: Line of therapy itself is unclear; no clear progression.
cases.evidence: Questionable whether carboplatin was given as first-line metastatic therapy or in the adjuvant setting. No clear progression documented in the available notes.

cases.why: Assessment says first-line failed; addendum says ongoing first-line with SD.
cases.evidence: Assessment: first-line therapy failed, proceed to second-line. Addendum later the same day: patient continues first-line carboplatin with stable disease; do not change therapy.

cases.why: One span denies systemic therapy; another describes six cycles of first-line then progression.
cases.evidence: Intake note: never received systemic therapy. Later oncology note: progressed after six cycles of first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel.

cases.why: Referring statement of failure vs local review that first-line never started.
cases.evidence: Failed first-line per referring oncologist. Our chart review: first-line systemic therapy was never started; patient received palliative radiotherapy only.

cases.why: Same first-line regimen described as progressed and as excellent ongoing response.
cases.evidence: Progressed on carboplatin/paclitaxel (first-line). Later note: excellent ongoing response to first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel; continue current treatment.
